description.zh-Hans: 这是一个在末日之下的世界，大部分陆地被海水淹没，仅存的岛屿各自为战……少女I从实验室醒来，家人，人类的未来，究竟怎样的选择才是正确的？
description.en: This is a world under apocalypse, most of the land is submerged by seawater, and the remaining islands fight each other... Girl I wakes up from the laboratory. Family, the future of humanity, what choice is correct?
